title: New tram timetables on routes 1, 3, 5, 6, 16, 64, 67 and 72
articleDescription: On 12 October 2026, we’re introducing new tram timetables on routes 1, 3, 5, 6, 16, 64, 67 and 72 to make services more reliable.
articleContent:
The new timetables will make services more reliable and deliver a better experience for passengers.
Passengers should check their timetables and plan ahead before they travel.

To plan your journey:

  • Download the PTV App
  • Use the journey planner
  • Check the new timetables for:
    • Route 1
    • Route 3
    • Route 5
    • Route 6
    • Route 16
    • Route 64
    • Route 67
    • Route 72
  • or call 1800 800 007
